method: Manual whole4files reading; pinned Git bytes matched. No native UI/runtime execution.
findings: Color button lazily creates preview child on paint, destroys it on parent destroy, forwards preview click to parent. Color selection commits and sends WM_NOTIFY only when picker returns value; cancel leaves color unchanged by this handler.

XYSlider Initialize derives pixel range from odd client dimensions minus fixed8pixel gripper. SetRange assigns external range and SetPos converts without explicit range/nonzero validation. Tiny/zero geometry or custom zero range can invalidate conversion assumptions; actual GUI not tested.
DoMoveBy clamps pixel coordinates then converts rounded external values and notifies parent only on external-value change. Direct SetPos invalidates but does not notify or clamp.

Drag captures mouse, retains grab offset, clamps drag bounds, dispatches nested messages and releases capture on exit; no rollback to original value on capture loss or Escape-specific cancel handler visible.
Nested drag loop treats GetMessage0as exit without reposting WM_QUIT and does not explicitly handle negative GetMessage error. Shutdown/capture-loss behavior unqualified.
Double-click gripper resets center; outside gripper advances10pixels toward point using hypot. This interaction semantics differs from settings numeric validation; no duplicate-search guarantee.
limits: No Windows paint, capture, keyboard, cancel, geometry or division-boundary runtime tests.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred.
